description: Answers 'is dealer gamma long or short for this ticker - where are the gamma flip, call wall and put wall?' Give a ticker plus start/end for a time series, or a date alone for every name that session ranked by absolute net gamma. Returns one row per ticker per session: spot, net/call/put gamma in $bn per 1% move, flip, call/put walls, put-call open-interest ratio and at-the-money IV, each stamped with knowledge_time (17:00 New York). Point-in-time GEX for US stocks, ETFs and major indexes. A ticker series also returns `summary`: regime (long/short gamma), distance to the flip and walls, and a one-line read to quote. Free keys get the last 30 days; full history with a FinzData plan. meta.upgrade lists the available history options to show the user.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_gex
title: Get point-in-time GEX (dealer gamma)
